title: FEMTO/PRONOSTIA Bearing1_1 (IEEE PHM 2012), measured run to failure
source: FEMTO-ST Institute, PRONOSTIA platform; IEEE PHM 2012 Data Challenge. Nectoux et al., IEEE ICPHM 2012.
